description: Call any ClickUp REST endpoint directly (escape hatch for full API coverage). Provide the HTTP method, the path AFTER the version segment (e.g. '/team' or '/task/abc123'), the api version ('v2' default, or 'v3' for Docs/Chat), optional query params and JSON body. Use this only when no dedicated tool exists. Auth, retries and rate-limiting are handled for you. Reference: https://developer.clickup.com/reference

path.description: Path after the version, starting with '/'. Example: '/team/123/space'.

name: clickup_raw
